_about: Pass and fail thresholds for verify.py. Written before the checks. 'estimate': true marks a number chosen by judgement, not measured; change it only with a written reason in the commit message. 'hard': the property must hold exactly.

criteria.why: an invalid line cannot be routed or buffered
an edge is a line
stored length must equal the geodesic length of the stored line
each edge must start at its src node and end at its dst node; a reversed one-way or a bad split breaks this
same nodes and same line twice doubles weights
near-zero edges come from duplicated OSM nodes; a few are normal
the router inner-joins both tables; a missing row silently removes the edge
advisory corridors exclude the via road by its gazetteer id
ways dropped by the vertex/node consistency check
trunk to tertiary roads in a city form one network; the rest is mapping gaps or extract edges
private campuses and service roads form small islands in OSM
share of car-usable length from which a car can reach everything else in the component; reversed one-ways lower it
an arterial ending in nothing, away from the extract border, is a mapping or split error
nodes a car can enter but not leave (one-way traps), away from the extract border
a scooter is smaller than a car in every dimension the mask uses
same reasoning, truck vs car
OSM motorcycle=no or private must close the edge to two-wheelers
OSM motorcar=no or access=no must close the edge to cars
OSM hgv=no must close the edge to trucks
a scooter may use every car road; the 70 vs 90 km/h cap allows it to be up to about 15% slower, never more
with the tape-measured width, who-fits must match who was seen passing
a car route must never use a gate a car was seen unable to pass
every known pair, for each vehicle listed, must route
a pin far from the road means the road is missing or the wrong vehicle mask was used
car route length against OSRM on the same OSM file; the speed models differ, the road network does not
a 50% gap means a missing road, a wrong one-way or a wrong exclusion, not a speed difference
pairs where at least half the roads you named for your usual route appear in DetourAI's route
DetourAI time divided by your usual time, inside 0.35 to 1.2: it uses free-flow speeds, so it should be faster than real traffic but not absurdly
pairs with a recorded trip where at least 70% of DetourAI's route lies within 30 m of what you actually drove
share of recorded positions within 25 m of a road in the graph; the rest are missing roads, GPS error or parking lots
where a car actually drove, the graph must allow a car
where a scooter actually rode, the graph must allow a scooter
a car driving against a mapped one-way usually means the one-way is wrong in OSM or reversed by the import (scooters are reported, not judged)
advisories expected to make a zone where the parser found a place name
of parsed ones, every place name matched a gazetteer feature
advisories expected to make a zone that produced a non-empty zone
placed zones covering at least 60% of the stretch you marked, with at most 60% of the zone area farther than 150 m from it
placed zones covering under 10% of the marked stretch: the costliest error, a closure drawn somewhere else
advisories you marked as no road action, or as lifted, that still produced a zone
median /v1/route wall time on your pairs, warm
95th percentile /v1/route wall time
pg_stat_statements mean execution time of the pgr_bdDijkstra call
every migration re-applied and committed a second time must succeed
re-applying must not change tables, columns, indexes, functions or seed rows
rebuilding from the same OSM tables must give the same edges, masks and lengths
same features per class and same road links
hand-mapped gates, sinks and submersion alert history must survive a re-import
after the worker is killed and started, every enabled source is polled again within 120 s
no message stored twice, no zone made twice from one advisory, no alert sent twice
blind review: share of pairs where the reviewer picked DetourAI's route or said both were fine
blind review: the reviewer marks a road on DetourAI's route as impossible for that vehicle
